messages.author: f6edc1636bb6e59a
messages.subject: Survival analysis in Lavaan?
parts:
Hello,

I'm interested in conducting a discrete time survival analysis via latent variable modeling (e.g., Muthén & Masyn, 2005, though simpler without the mixture component). I would like to use lavaan.

Muthén, B., & Masyn, K. (2005). Discrete-time survival mixture analysis. Journal of Educational and Behavioral statistics, 30(1), 27-58.

I'm curious if anyone knows of an example using lavaan or any differences in conducting this analysis in lavaan compared to Mplus that I should be aware of?

Thanks in advance,

Dan

messages.author: f6edc1636bb6e59a
messages.subject: Re: Survival analysis in Lavaan?
parts: I should also add that some of my predictors will be latent variables with indicators best treated as ordered categories.
